title: Valid label for a component representative
statement: Let $q$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $G$ be a finite unique game with a nonempty finite set of variables and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences. Each constraint joins two distinct variables and carries a permutation of the $q$ labels, and every variable occurs in a constraint. A label in $	ext{Fin}(q)$ for a component representative is valid if, for every constraint whose source lies in that component, applying the constraint's permutation to the label transported from the target along its component path gives the label transported from the source along its component path.
hypotheses_covered: The variable set is finite and nonempty
The constraint-occurrence set is finite and nonempty
Each constraint carries a permutation of the $q$ labels
Every variable occurs in a constraint
A connected component and a label in $	ext{Fin}(q)$ are specified
